feature_description: The weather on Today, and family photos and weather on family displays.
cap_photos: Show family photos on a display
cap_manage: Set up display photos and weather
subtitle: The weather on Today, and the photos and weather that screens on the wall show. The weather is the only thing that comes from the internet; the screens themselves never call anything.
photos_intro: When nobody is using a display, it shows a slideshow of these photos.
photos_hint: Photos are shrunk on this device before they are sent, and details such as the location are not kept. JPEG, PNG and WebP work.
photos_none: No photos yet. Displays show a calm clock until you add some.
weather_enable: Show the weather on Today and on displays
weather_privacy: The place you choose is sent to Open-Meteo.com, rounded to about one kilometre, to get the forecast. Nothing else is sent.
weather_no_results: No place found. Check the spelling, or try a bigger town nearby.
setup_place_later: You can also do this later from Today's checklist.
setup_place_intro: FamilyOS can show the weather on Today and on wall displays. Search for your city or town. Only the name you type is sent to Open-Meteo, a free weather service. You can change it later in Settings.
timing_intro: After a while without a touch, a display shows photos, the clock and the weather. Touching the screen brings the widgets back.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
weather_unavailable: The weather is not available right now.
atmosphere_hint: Set your city to see the weather
wx_say_dry_sunny: Sunny and dry all day, {{max}}° by {{time}}.
